reason: After reviewing the complete 10-K filing text (all 200,000+ tokens scanned), Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. does not disclose any total addressable market (TAM) figures. The filing contains extensive operational, financial, and business segment information about their sand/proppant production, logistics, and power generation businesses, but no company-disclosed TAM, market size estimates, or serviceable addressable market figures were found. The company discusses customer concentrations, revenue by segment, and operational capacity, but does not quantify the overall market opportunity in monetary or unit terms using any company-sourced TAM disclosure.
